FM-1.name: Silent Manifest Field Omission
FM-1.mechanism: Strict manifest schema validation rejecting unknown CSV columns/JSON keys with row-indexed errors.

FM-2.name: OOD Plant Task Ambiguity
FM-2.mechanism: Explicit evaluation task requirements (disease, gate, both). OOD species must specify gate task.

FM-3.name: Silently Truncated Evaluation
FM-3.mechanism: Runner fails closed on manifest errors unless --allow-exploratory-subset is explicitly passed.

FM-4.name: Filesystem Traversal & Symlink Escape
FM-4.mechanism: Authoritative path resolver checks '..' tokens, resolves symlinks, and enforces dataset root containment.

FM-5.name: Unvalidated Gate Sidecar Config
FM-5.mechanism: Validates classes, order, output dimensions, and required fields; raises GateIntegrityError on corrupt sidecars.

FM-6.name: Validation Split Baseline Substitution
FM-6.mechanism: Requires genuine held-out test split ('test'); rejects val_accuracy and val_macro_f1 as substitutes.

FM-7.name: Unvalidated Model Softmax Outputs
FM-7.mechanism: Verifies 15-class shape, float dtype, finite values, range [-0.01, 1.01], and unit sum (1.0 +/- 0.01).

FM-8.name: False Bootstrap CI on Low Cluster Count
FM-8.mechanism: Reports macro_f1_ci_available = False and None interval when clusters < 5 or sample size < 10.

FM-9.name: Zero-Denominator Misleading Metric
FM-9.mechanism: Denominators with support = 0 return None and render as N/A (support=0) instead of misleading 0.0.

FM-10.name: Uncounted Failed Inferences
FM-10.mechanism: InferenceAccounting tracks total, valid, attempted, successful, failed, failure rate, and failure-adjusted accuracy.
